Yes, we’re super excited to say we do ship internationally! Our beautiful custom jewellery can reach you almost anywhere in the world.

Here’s a quick rundown on customs and duties:

For most European countries (like the UK, France, Germany, Spain, and more), import taxes and duties are included in the price—so there are no extra charges when your order arrives.
For the USA, from 16 May 2025, a 30% tariff will apply to your purchase due to new government regulations. These charges are set by the US government and are the customer’s responsibility.
For the rest of the world, any customs charges are set by your local authorities and will need to be covered by you. We always recommend checking with your local customs office if you want to be sure about any possible fees.

We’re so excited for you to receive your Abbott Lyon goodies, wherever you are! If you need more details, you can check out our full shipping info here: Shipping Policy. 🧡
